text:
Hidden beneath your fleet the sea groans, sail calls wind, and heaven promises the Turk's crescents eclipse on your campaign.


Your sword wishes in English veins to quench Spanish thirst, while the sun sees his brightness increased in your arms.


Perhaps envious earth arms triumphant armies against you, powerful in proud monsters;


seeing your right hand armed with lightning, O Jupiter, I think giants returned to the world.

translation.title: To King Philip III
